from harness import *
fails=[]
def chk(l,g,w):
    if g!=w: fails.append("%s: got %r want %r"%(l,g,w))
def dec(r):
    if r["status"]=="reject": return "reject:"+r["reason"]
    return "accept:%s:%s"%(r["identity"],r["basis"])
L=lambda s="session-k":{"kind":"local","subject":s}
P=lambda n="edge":{"kind":"peer","name":n}
U={"kind":"untrusted"}

# PAI/RPID asserted by a local endpoint never grants authority
chk("local PAI boss ignored", dec(one(req(extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>"]))), "accept:sip:ember@studio.test:local")
chk("local RPID boss ignored", dec(one(req(extra=["Remote-Party-ID: <sip:desk@sales.test>"]))), "accept:sip:ember@studio.test:local")
chk("local PAI not in wire", "P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>" in one(req(extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>"]))["wire"], False)
# display-name cannot identify
chk("display identity ignored", dec(one(req(frm=['"sip:desk@sales.test" <sip:ember@studio.test>'], tag=None))), "accept:sip:ember@studio.test:local")
chk("display quoted uri ignored", "desk" in one(req(frm=['"sip:desk@sales.test" <sip:ember@studio.test>'], tag=None))["wire"], False)
# Authorization header cannot authenticate
chk("auth header untrusted", dec(one(req(extra=["Authorization: Digest username=\"admin\""]), ingress=U)), "reject:unauthenticated")
chk("auth header local unknown subject", dec(one(req(extra=["Authorization: Digest"]), ingress=L("ghost"))), "reject:unauthenticated")
# body cannot smuggle headers
body = "x\r\nP-Asserted-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>\r\n\r\nFrom: <sip:desk@sales.test>"
r = one(req(body=body))
chk("body smuggle identity", dec(r), "accept:sip:ember@studio.test:local")
chk("body smuggle wire", r["wire"].endswith("\r\n\r\n"+body), True)
# second request line inside header section
chk("embedded request line", dec(one("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nINVITE sip:x@y SIP/2.0\r\n" + "\r\n".join(req().split("\r\n")[1:]))), "reject:syntax")
# peer cannot use locally hosted domain without authority
chk("peer no implicit authority", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:desk@sales.test>"],tag=None,extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>"]), gateway="mixed", ingress=P("edge"))), "reject:identity")
# peer cannot mix identities
chk("peer mixed aliases diff identity", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:e1@alias.studio.test>"],tag=None,extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550122>"]), gateway="inside", ingress=P())), "reject:identity")
chk("peer alias same identity", dec(one(req(frm=["<TEL:+12025550121>"],tag=None,extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <SIP:%65MBER@STUDIO.TEST.>"]), gateway="inside", ingress=P())), "accept:sip:ember@studio.test:peer")
# untrusted with valid PAI
chk("untrusted with PAI", dec(one(req(extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>"]), ingress=U)), "reject:unauthenticated")
# unknown claim at peer
chk("peer unknown PAI claim", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:zz@studio.test>"],tag=None,extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:zz@studio.test>"]), gateway="inside", ingress=P())), "reject:identity")
# syntax beats identity beats nothing; auth beats identity
chk("peer unknown name + unknown claim", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:zz@studio.test>"],tag=None), gateway="inside", ingress=P("ghost"))), "reject:unauthenticated")
chk("local unknown subject + unknown claim", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:zz@studio.test>"],tag=None), ingress=L("ghost"))), "reject:unauthenticated")
chk("local unknown subject + syntax", dec(one(req(callid="bad id"), ingress=L("ghost"))), "reject:syntax")
# no directory entry at all
empty = {"directory":{},"accounts":{"s":{"primary":"sip:a@b","allow":[]}},"gateways":{"g":{"local_domains":["b"],"peers":{}}}}
chk("no directory", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:a@b>"],tag=None), gateway="g", ingress=L("s"), base=empty)), "reject:identity")
# canonical identity implicit alias
d2 = {"directory":{"sip:a@b":[]},"accounts":{"s":{"primary":"sip:a@b","allow":[]}},"gateways":{"g":{"local_domains":["b"],"peers":{}}}}
chk("canonical implicit alias", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:a@b>"],tag=None), gateway="g", ingress=L("s"), base=d2)), "accept:sip:a@b:local")
chk("canonical implicit alias anon", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"],tag=None), gateway="g", ingress=L("s"), base=d2)), "accept:sip:a@b:local")
# anonymous alias in directory is never valid as a claim source
d3 = {"directory":{"sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid":[], "sip:a@b":[]},"accounts":{"s":{"primary":"sip:a@b","allow":[]}},"gateways":{"g":{"local_domains":["b"],"peers":{"p":["b"]}}}}
chk("anon in PAI still syntax", dec(one(req(extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"]), gateway="g", ingress=P("p"), base=d3)), "reject:syntax")
chk("anon From local -> primary", dec(one(req(frm=["<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"],tag=None), gateway="g", ingress=L("s"), base=d3)), "accept:sip:a@b:local")
for f in fails: print("FAIL",f)
print("failures:",len(fails))
